model_annotation: Figure 1 presents three separate donut charts comparing the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four economic sectors in 2021, with each chart showing absolute values as percentages of the total sector in the economy. Each chart contains four colored segments representing the sectors: industry (yellow), construction (blue), trade (red), and other services (dark blue). In the 'Number of Enterprises' chart, the industry sector accounts for 61% (19.0 million), construction for 12% (3.7 million), trade for 19% (5.9 million), and other services for 8% (2.4 million). In the 'Number of Persons Employed' chart, the construction sector accounts for 51% (89.2 million), industry for 21% (33.0 million), trade for 19% (29.5 million), and other services for 9% (13.4 million). In the 'Turnover' chart, the trade sector accounts for 31% (9.8 billion), industry for 31% (9.8 billion), construction for 33% (10.6 billion), and other services for 6% (1.9 billion). Each chart includes a legend identifying the color associated with each sector, and percentages are displayed as labels within each respective segment. The charts are arranged side by side, with no visual indication of a specific ordering of segments by size.
